Rust receipt matching originally reparsed checksum-free original frames with a checksum-requiring parser. Matching now uses the same validated parser copy as the proof, preserving originals.
Review exposed checksum synthesis not bound to the plan mode and local identity deduplication hiding duplicate replies. Both were dynamically reproduced and tightened before final validation.
The raw envelope must also match the Rust strict reader: uppercase wire hex and one CR, LF or CRLF terminator. Looser hex/terminator acceptance was reproduced and refused.
